title: Director of Engineering
jobDescription:
About Hevo Hevo is an automated unified data platform that helps organizations effortlessly move and sync data across 150+ sources to modern cloud data warehouses like Snowflake, Big Query, and Redshift — all with no-code and real-time capabilities. We’re on a mission to empower teams to make faster, data-driven decisions by simplifying data integration at scale. Key Responsibilities Engineering Leadership & Strategy ● Define the long-term technical vision and engineering roadmap in alignment with Hevo’s product and business strategy. ● Build and scale engineering teams, fostering a high-performance culture rooted in ownership and innovation. ● Serve as a thought partner to the CXO, Ho E and leadership team on product and platform evolution. Architecture & Technical Direction ● Lead architectural decisions for a large-scale, real-time data platform ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability. ● Drive modernization across ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and metadata systems. ● Evaluate emerging technologies and adopt those that advance the platform’s capabilities and efficiency. ● Champion technical excellence and establish best practices across the org. Delivery & Execution ● Oversee end-to-end product delivery, ensuring timely releases with high quality and customer impact. ● Build robust engineering processes (planning, reviews, incident management) to support rapid scaling. ● Partner closely with product management to align priorities and balance speed with long-term maintainability. ● Drive execution discipline while maintaining a bias for speed and innovation. People & Organizational Development ● Attract, develop, and retain top engineering talent across multiple domains. ● Build leadership capacity within engineering through mentorship and succession planning. AI-Native Engineering & Platform Intelligence ● Drive adoption of LLM-powered developer productivity tools to accelerate engineering throughput. ● Leverage AI to improve observability, incident triaging, and root cause analysis across distributed ingestion systems. ● Architect AI-assisted features for customers (e.g., automated connector mapping, transformation suggestions, query optimization). ● Establish responsible AI practices including governance, evaluation frameworks, and model performance monitoring. ● Identify opportunities to reduce operational overhead through automation and AI-driven decision systems. ● Embed AI/ML capabilities into the core platform (e.g., anomaly detection, pipeline health intelligence, intelligent retries, data quality insights). Why Consider Leading the Engineering at Hevo At Hevo, you will be leading the team working on one of the most technically challenging and impactful problems in modern data infrastructure: building a highly reliable, fault-tolerant data pipeline that powers decision-making for 2000+ enterprise companies across 40+ countries, including industry leaders like Shopify, Door Dash, Postman, and Zepto. The Core Challenge Companies today run on hundreds of business applications and databases. Each of these data sources evolves constantly. The structure of the data can change without warning, APIs behave unpredictably, and edge cases surface every day. Yet our customers rely on Hevo to unify all this data into their warehouses at internet scale. Scale & Technology The scale we operate at captures the magnitude of our engineering challenges ● 2000 companies across 40+ countries use Hevo. ● 150+ data sources with pre-built, battle-tested connectors ● 200GB/hour data transfer rate for each pipeline ● About 40k Pipelines ● 6 billion events processed per day ● 1PB+ data processed monthly Our tech stack is built for this scale: AWS Fargate, Apache Kafka, Rocks DB, My SQL, Mongo DB, Redis, Influx DB, and Temporal, orchestrating multiple microservices across multi-tenant, auto-scaling infrastructure. AI at the Core, Not Just the Surface At Hevo, we build the infrastructure that makes AI possible in the first place. Without reliable, high-quality data, RAG breaks with stale or missing documents, agents hallucinate and take wrong actions, and copilots surface responses that can’t be trusted. Beyond powering AI with clean, trustworthy data, we’re actively embedding AI directly into the heart of our core product. For example, one of our core initiatives is around building agents that behave like developers
- autonomously creating, testing, and validating new data connectors. Work with the Best Engineering Minds You'll be working alongside engineers who've built systems at scale before at companies like Flipkart, Amazon, Linkedin, Microsoft, Oracle and Razorpay. These are smart, kind, and hardworking colleagues who bring deep expertise in distributed systems and are passionate about solving complex technical problems. Why This Work Matters Unlike much of the work in large organizations, the problems that engineering solves at Hevo are deeply technical and core to the company’s mission. Your work is not an add-on. It is the foundation. Every design decision directly impacts data reliability for some of the fastest-growing companies in the world. Unique Advantage of Building at Hevo India There are very few companies in India that build true data infrastructure products at this scale. In most global companies, the most complex and challenging engineering work happens outside India, while local teams handle peripheral or execution-heavy roles. Hevo is different. Our entire engineering team is based in India. Every engineer works on the toughest problems, has full visibility into the product architecture, and contributes directly to the company's core technology. The learning and the impact are real and immediate. Who Should Not Join Hevo Hevo is not for everyone. We are solving deeply complex technical problems that demand rigor, creativity, and persistence. You may not be a fit if: ● You do not enjoy working on complex challenges or diving deep into the crux of a problem ● You are not passionate about building high-performance, high-quality, and scalable products used by thousands of large-scale customers ● You are looking for a settled role in a company that moves at a slow and steady pace. At Hevo, we move fast, but without breaking things Join Us We're at the perfect inflection point. We are at a scale where the technical challenges are massive but the team is still small enough that every engineer shapes the product's architecture and future. The data infrastructure market is exploding. AI is creating unprecedented demand for reliable, real-time data. And we're building the foundational technology that will power the next generation of AI-native companies. Qualification ● 15+ years of experience ● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field required; Master’s degree preferred

title: Product Manager
jobDescription:
Product Manager
- Hevo The Hard Thing About Data Most companies that claim to have a "data platform" have a dashboard with some charts and a dream. Hevo has something different. Something that took eight years to build and can't be bought. Over 2,000 companies send us their most sensitive data every single day. 100 billion events a month. Raw. Unfiltered. Before transformation, before aggregation, at the exact moment truth is created. That's not a product feature. That's trust, earned one customer at a time, over eight years, by not screwing up. That position is now the foundation for something much bigger. We're building an Intelligence Layer on top of it, a system that reads across every data source a company runs, connects the signals that matter, and tells people what to do before they have to go looking for answers. We call it the Context Graph. It's real enough to show results. Early enough that the person who joins now defines what it becomes. This is the moment. Not the moment after it's obvious. Now. What You're Walking Into You'll own a product pod. Saa S integrations, database connectors, or the Intelligence Layer, depending on where the biggest need is when you join. You own the backlog. More importantly, you own the why behind everything that gets built. You report directly to the CEO. In the first 3-6 months, your job is to make the foundation bulletproof, find the gaps in the platform, close them, and make the product sharper than it's ever been. After that, you move into the Intelligence Layer and help define what Hevo becomes in its next chapter. What This Job Actually Is Let's be honest about what great PMs do, and what mediocre ones do instead. Mediocre PMs write specs and hand them off. They synthesize feedback from CSMs and call it customer insight. They sit in architecture meetings and nod. They measure their own output in documents shipped, not outcomes delivered. That's not this job. This job is three things, done well, simultneously. First: technical ownership. You will be in the room when architecture decisions get made. Not watching. Contributing. Pushing back. Asking the questions that change the direction of the decision. You need to understand how data pipelines work at a systems level, CDC, connectors, streaming, schema management, failure modes. If you can't hold your own in that room, engineering will stop inviting you to it. And they'll be right to. Second: direct customer engagement. You talk to customers yourself. No intermediary. No secondhand summary. You hear the problem in the customer's own words, you sit with the complexity of it, and you own the translation into product decisions. If you're relying on a CSM to tell you what customers need, you will always be one step behind. Third: making complexity simple. Hevo's product is deeply technical. The people who sell it and support it are not always. A big part of your job is taking complex system behavior and making it crisp and understandable, for Support, for CS, for Solutions Engineering, so they can represent the product confidently to customers. If internal teams are confused, customers will be too. Who We're Looking For 6-8 years of product experience. Meaningful time on platform or infrastructure products at B2B companies. Not optional. Strong technical depth. CS degree or equivalent engineering background. You should be able to hold a real conversation about system design, data architecture, API design, and engineering tradeoffs, not a surface level one. Proven ability to engage directly with customers. Not customer research. Not user interviews handed to you by a researcher. Direct engagement, gathering requirements, presenting product direction, handling objections in real time. Clear, structured communication. Written and verbal. You can make a complex system understandable to a non-technical audience without sacrificing accuracy. This is rarer than it sounds. High ownership. You don't wait for conditions to be perfect. You move. You iterate. You follow through. When you say you'll do something, it gets done. Nice to have: Engineer-turned-PM. Experience at a Series A-C company where you had to balance speed with quality. Familiarity with the data integration and pipeline landscape. What Good Looks Like in Year One After 12 months, a great hire will have: Full, unambiguous ownership of their pod's backlog, with a defensible point of view on priorities that's grounded in customer reality and business impact. Identified and closed the most critical gaps in their product area, with improvements that customers and internal teams can actually feel. Built enough technical depth to shape architecture decisions, not observe them. Become the person in the company most connected to what customers actually need from their product area. Made internal teams measurably better at representing the product. Started actively shaping the Intelligence Layer, contributing product thinking and customer insight as Hevo moves into its next chapter. The Moment Hevo spent eight years building both a product and a business simultaneously, and the foundation is real. The Intelligence Layer is early. The window to define what it becomes is open right now. Most people will look at this moment in five years and wish they'd been here for it. If you're one of the people who wants to be here for it, let's talk.

title: Strategy & Ops (Founder's Office)
jobDescription:
Read this part first Experience: 2 to 8 years Location: HSR Layout, BLR Most Strategy and Operations roles quietly turn into reporting jobs. You pull the numbers, format the decks, and remind people about deadlines. This is not that role. This is the role for someone who wants to learn, at close range, how a fast growing company actually plans, prioritizes, and executes. You will work directly with the CEO and the leadership team on the problems that cut across functions, the ones no single team can solve alone. Your job is to turn ambiguity into a plan, and a plan into results. For the right person, this also happens to be one of the best leadership educations available anywhere. People who do this job well at Hevo build the instincts of a real operator, and many go on to run things. But the simplest reason to take it is this: you get to work on what matters most, alongside the people who decide it. What you will own:
1. The operational rhythm of the whole company. You will work with the CEO to keep the entire machine moving across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Engineering, HR, Solutions, and Support. You will run the OKR process with the leadership team, drive quarterly planning and goal setting, and track delivery so nothing important slips. You will be the person who can tell, on any given day, how healthy the organization really is and where attention is needed next.
2. The strategic projects that move the needle. You will partner with the CEO and other leaders to spot the initiatives that genuinely change the trajectory of the business, then own them end to end until they are big enough to stand on their own and get handed to a dedicated team. These are the bets that matter most, and you will be trusted to carry them.
3. Cross functional execution and alignment. You will be the connective tissue across functions, driving communication so the company moves as one. You will be a real thought partner to leadership on vision, priorities, and the hard tradeoffs. You will manage relationships with stakeholders inside and outside the company, and when needed, represent leadership in reviews. Why this role is special: Three things make this seat genuinely rare. You get the full view. Most people spend a decade seeing one function. You will see all of them at once, from the vantage point of the executive team, inside a company growing fast enough to teach you something new every week. You work on first of a kind problems. Nearly every problem you solve will be one you have not solved before. There is no playbook handed to you. You build the playbook. For the right person, that is the most fun part of the job. You build an operator's judgment. Custodian of rhythm, owner of strategic projects, thought partner to leadership. That is the exact muscle set strong operators and founders are made of. You will leave this role with judgment most people take many more years to develop. What you will need to bring: We hire for abilities first, because knowledge and skills can be taught and abilities are far harder to build. Here is what we are really looking for.
1. Stakeholder management. You build trust with people at every level and quickly read what actually drives them. People want to work with you, and they tell you the truth.
2. People leadership. You understand what good leadership looks like up close. You know how to find the right levers and use them to bring out strong performance, and you have nudged teams into action in a way that energized them.
3. First principles problem solving. You are sharp with data, analytics, and reasoning. You break unfamiliar problems down to their fundamentals and build your way back up to a clear answer.
4. Ownership. You take a problem and you get it solved, full stop. You enjoy the wins, you own the misses, and you fix them. High accountability, no excuses.
5. Outwork and outsmart. You bring operational rigour and intensity. You find the smarter path, and you also do the work.
6. Independent thinking. You form your own point of view from the inputs in front of you, build conviction, and have the courage to make the call.
7. High agency. You move things forward mostly through influence, rarely through authority. You align people around the company wide goal by convincing them, not commanding them. Who tends to thrive here: The people who do exceptionally well in this seat usually share a pattern. They are intensely curious about how businesses work. They are comfortable being thrown into something they have never done and figuring it out. They care more about the outcome than the credit. And they have the energy to keep going when a problem turns out to be harder than it first looked, because that is usually where the most interesting work begins.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
jobDescription:
Read this first Most TA manager jobs are about keeping the machine running. This one is about building the machine. If you want a role where the process is already built and you just run it, this is not the one. If you want to build the operating system that brings the best engineering and GTM talent in the country to Hevo, and gives them the best hiring experience of their careers, keep reading. Here is the honest picture. We hire strong people. Our product is trusted by companies like Door Dash, Shopify, and Postman. Our Glassdoor sits at a healthy 4.1, and our team is talented and hungry. The machine works. Now we get to make it exceptional. That is the opportunity. Today a lot of what makes hiring work at Hevo runs on the strength of our people. The job is to build the system underneath them so the excellence compounds and scales with us. That means every candidate hears back faster than they expect. It means every brilliant person our CEO reaches out to on Linked In gets a clean, closed loop from the team. It means stakeholders get crisp written visibility, not just a good update on a call. And it means the whole team pitches Hevo the way our best people already do. Nobody has yet owned turning TA into a well oiled machine, and that is exactly what makes this one of the most exciting building jobs in the company right now. What you will actually own
1. Closing the roles that matter, on time, every week. You own the outcome, not the activity. Priorities shift week to week, so every recruiter always knows their top three and is filling those funnels with candidates good enough to convert. When a loop stalls, you unblock it before the candidate cools off. The measure is simple: are the right roles closing, and closing fast.
2. Making our hiring process the best one a candidate runs all year. Great candidates are interviewing at four places, not one, and we win on respect as much as brand. A status update lands within a fixed window at every stage, nobody chases us, and every loop closes with a clear next step or an honest no, including the ones the CEO sources himself. You will see it in our offer accept rate.
3. Giving the business sharp, written visibility into hiring. We are good on a call and weak on paper. You fix that with one standard written update per function each week: pipeline, conversion, time to close, and roles at risk. Leaders read it async and know exactly where things stand. Numbers, not vibes.
4. Building a team that sells Hevo and runs a clean process. You inherit a talented team that has never had a real training path, and you build one: how to tell the Hevo story, screen with judgment, and run a tight loop end to end. The goal is to lift the whole floor, so selling Hevo is something everyone does well, not one person.
5. Turning all of this into a repeatable system. None of this is a one-time cleanup. You codify it, sourcing to offer, into SOPs on the Hevo hiring framework, and own the employer branding fundamentals: Glassdoor, our Linked In presence, and the collateral candidates actually see. What the first year looks like Month 1 to 2: You know every open role, every recruiter's strengths, and exactly where the funnel leaks. The candidate communication SLA is live and enforced. The CEO's Linked In candidates never fall through the cracks again. Month 3 to 6: The weekly written update is a habit stakeholders rely on. Time to close is trending down on priority roles. The team's training path is built and running. Month 6 to 12: TA runs like a system, not a scramble. The process is documented, the team sells Hevo with confidence, and our candidate experience is something people mention in interviews at other companies. Who you are You have 8 to 11 years in recruiting, with at least 2 to 3 spent managing recruiters or owning a hiring vertical end to end. You have hired across both engineering and GTM. Not one or the other. SDE roles and AE, SDR, SE roles are both familiar territory. You have built or genuinely upgraded a hiring process before, not just executed someone else's playbook. You come from a place with a high hiring bar, ideally a high growth B2B Saa S or product company. You write clearly and you enjoy it. Given where the team is today, this one is non-negotiable. You know the India talent market and the tools we live in: Linked In, Instahyre, IIMJobs. Who this is not for If you need a fully built process handed to you, you will find this messy. The mess is the opportunity, but you have to want it. If you avoid hard conversations with hiring managers or with your own team, the accountability part of this role will wear you down. If you would rather report progress on a call than write it down, we are not going to fit. Why Hevo We are building a category-defining data product from India, for the world. Backed by Sequoia, Chiratae, and Qualgro, with over 2,000 customers across 40+ countries and hyper-growth ahead. The talent you bring in over the next two years is the talent that builds that future. Very few roles tie hiring this directly to the outcome of the company. This is one of them. If this sounds like the job you have been waiting to build, we should talk.

jobDescription:
About Hevo: Postman, Zepto, Thought Spot, Whatfix, Shopify, Door Dash and thousands of other data-driven companies share one thing. They all use Hevo Data's fully managed Automated Pipelines to consolidate their data from multiple sources like Databases, Marketing Applications, Cloud Storage, SDKs, Streaming Services, etc. We are a San Francisco/Bangalore-based company with 2000+ customers spread across 40+ countries in domains such as e-commerce, financial technology, and healthcare. Strongly backed by marquee investors like Sequoia Capital, Chiratae, and Qualgro, we have raised $43 Million to date and are looking forward to our next phase of hyper-growth! Why do we exist? Every company today wants to leverage cutting-edge technology
- Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Predictive Analytics
- to make smarter business decisions. Data is the foundational block on which these advanced techniques can be applied. However, every company's business users struggle to access accurate and reliable data. Data resides fragmented across the 100s of business software that businesses use. Most of the data operators spend time manually consolidating it, and they spend too little time deriving insights. If this ‘collection’ can be automated, it can lead to making business decisions faster, unlocking exponential growth, and delivering a superior experience to customers. At Hevo, our mission is to enable every company to be data-driven. We started on this journey 4 years back, and as the first step in this direction, we built our first product – “Data Pipeline” or simply “Pipeline”. Hevo Pipeline is a no-code platform that helps companies connect all their data sources within the company to get a unified view of their business. The platform offers integrations with 150+ data sources, such as Databases, Saa S applications, Advertising, and Channels. Today, we enable nearly 2000 companies across more than 40+ countries to be more data-driven. We aim to make the technology so simple that anyone can solve their data problems without being limited due to their lack of technical skills. Product Demo and our customers love us

title: Video Marketer
jobDescription:
Video Marketer About Hevo: Hevo is a simple, no-code data pipeline platform that helps companies unify and prepare their data for analytics and AI—effortlessly. Every meaningful AI advancement starts with one critical foundation: clean, unified, and accessible data. Hevo enables 2,500+ data-driven companies—including Door Dash, Shopify, Postman, Cox Automotive, Neo4J, Arhaus, and Groww—to get their data AI-ready by automating complex integration and transformation workflows across hundreds of sources. By removing engineering bottlenecks, Hevo allows teams to focus on what truly matters—generating insights, building intelligent products, and making faster, smarter decisions. Role Overview: We are looking for a Video Marketer to join Hevo’s marketing team and own the end-to-end creation of high-quality video content that makes complex data engineering and B2B Saa S concepts compelling, clear, and watchable. This is a hands-on execution role requiring strong editing skills, sharp visual storytelling instincts, and a high personal bar for quality ,from raw brief to final render. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Edit and produce long-form and short-form video content across formats ,product explainers, customer stories, thought leadership pieces, and social clips ,from brief to final delivery. Translate scripts and written briefs into visually engaging video stories ,maintaining message fidelity while making confident creative decisions on pacing, transitions, motion graphics, and audio design. Build and animate motion graphics in Adobe After Effects, managing the full post-production pipeline across Adobe Premiere Pro and/or Da Vinci Resolve. Handle audio mixing end-to-end, to deliver a polished final mix. Collaborate with the content, design, and marketing teams to ensure all video output aligns with Hevo’s brand guidelines, visual identity, and campaign objectives. Proactively evaluate and implement new tools across AI video, audio enhancement, b-roll generation, and storyboard design to keep Hevo’s video production at the cutting edge. Plan and execute video shoots end-to-end ,operating Sony mirrorless cameras, setting up key and fill lighting rigs, configuring mic interfaces, and managing collar and boom mic setups to capture broadcast-quality footage. Self-review all deliverables before submission ,catching sync issues, render artifacts, and brief deviations independently, without waiting to be flagged. Required Skills &

QUALIFICATIONS:
Minimum of 1+ years of experience in Video Editing and Production. Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (strongly preferred) or Da Vinci Resolve ,must have used these tools on real projects, not just coursework. Strong working knowledge of Adobe After Effects ,ability to build, keyframe, and animate motion graphic timelines independently. Solid understanding of video editing fundamentals: cuts and transitions, pacing and sequencing, color correction, animation types, and visual rhythm and knowledge of audio mixing. Visual storytelling ability: Can interpret a written brief and make confident creative decisions about how to translate copy into a compelling video narrative without distorting the message. Strong attention to detail and a high personal quality bar ,proactively flags errors in scripts and briefs, and takes full ownership of output quality without needing to be prompted. Curiosity about and comfort with evolving tools ,AI video, generative b-roll, open-source audio software, and automation across the production workflow. Hands-on experience operating Sony mirrorless cameras, configuring key and fill lighting setups, and managing microphones and interfaces, comfortable directing and running a shoot independently. Prior experience in B2B, Saa S, or tech video content is a plus; familiarity with data engineering or analytics concepts is a strong bonus. What You’ll Gain: Full ownership of Hevo’s video output ,a rare opportunity to shape the visual identity of a fast-growing B2B Saa S brand with real creative autonomy. Exposure to a high-velocity content environment spanning product marketing, demand generation, and community ,across formats and audiences. A collaborative team that values speed, quality, and craft ,you’ll be trusted to make calls and grow your skills with real projects and real impact.
